messages.subject: Indigo - price
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Following the title report we want to push Tarncliffe to £14.25m, on the basis of the outstanding Unit 3 review and the Unit 5 break risk. Can you put that to Pendle Voss and hold firm? We're comfortable walking if they won't move below £14.4m.

Marcus

messages.subject: Meridian Quarter - price and timetable
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Having completed diligence, our client's position is £14,250,000, reflecting the unresolved Unit 3 review and the March 2027 tenant break on Unit 5. On that basis we can move quickly to exchange before the holidays, with completion in mid-February. Please take instructions.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
